identity.description: Consensus (consensus.app): an AI-powered scientific research search engine over peer-reviewed papers, with a REST search API, a Threads research-agent API, and a hosted MCP server. Not the same company as goconsensus.com (a sales-demo platform), which surfaced in search results and was excluded.
identity.identity_notes: consensus.app/llms.txt describes the product as a scientific-sources tool for agents via REST API or MCP server. Search results about goconsensus.com (app.goconsensus.com, Integrations/Access Credentials) describe a different product and were rejected.

auth.oauth_flows: MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration (per consensus.app/llms.txt). Browser sign-in on first MCP connection per search snippets.

access.production_restrictions: Pricing page describes API as optional, available upon approval, and rate limited for Team; Enterprise has custom pricing and limits (contact sales@consensus.app). No public self-serve free API tier was found in the sources read. MCP access tier for Free/Pro not confirmed because the MCP docs page returned HTTP 403.

resources: threads (Consensus Research Agent answers with citations)
api.rate_limits: Plan-based quotas; exact API rate limits not established (pricing page says 'rate limited'). Results-per-search caps reported by a summarizer: Pro and Team 300, Deep 750, Enterprise 1000.
api.limitations: Only search and thread endpoints seen; OpenAPI spec at docs.consensus.app/openapi.json returned 403 and could not be read. Protocols list 'REST' for the API and MCP (Streamable HTTP) is a hosted remote server, not a REST protocol; 'none' is a placeholder and should be ignored. Full endpoint list unverified.
